canonical_project: Vocus ASC (Australia Singapore Cable) landing station, Flying Fish Cove
notes: sub_location Flying Fish Cove / Settlement. ASC in service September 2018, 4,600 km Perth-Singapore via Christmas Island and Indonesia, capacity up to 60 Tbps (Vocus official page verified 2026-08-12). DITRDCA IOT bulletin 2018 (methodology-verified) places the cable landing station beside the Flying Fish Cove Administration building. COUNTED AS TELECOM/CABLE LANDING INFRASTRUCTURE - not commercial colocation (no rack/hosting/colo product confirmed for the island per CX methodology).
